# Scale Clamp

Shortens needle-shaped Gaussians that show up as streaks when you move away from the capture path.

`lfs.scale_clamp` · Splat

## How to use

Use when thin streaks appear off the camera path.\
Start with Max Aspect 16; lower values shorten more needles.\
Flat splats on surfaces are left alone unless 'Include flat' is on.\
Zero axes stay collapsed; aspect limits apply only to the remaining nonzero axes.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Where you apply the edit, 0–1: 0 leaves it unchanged, 1 applies it fully. Unconnected means everything. |
| Max Aspect | `Max Aspect` | lfs.float | 16 | min 1; step 0.1 | Largest allowed ratio between a splat's longest and middle axis. 16 is a good start; lower values shorten more needles. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Include Flat | `include_flat` | bool | false | — | Also limit flatness (longest vs shortest axis). Off by default, because surfaces are made of flat splats. |
